title: Canterbury Museum, Christchurch
geometryBasis: OSM way 23504437 version 7 and all twelve contemporaneous node positions establish the museum perimeter in January 2016. The Gothic street range and entrance face east along Rolleston Avenue.
sectionBasis: The January 2016 public-domain exterior records the dark masonry and pale trim, tall traceried windows, open porch, rose window and tower’s steep truncated roof. The connected rear galleries follow the archived outline with approximate roof subdivisions.
limitations: January 2016 exterior before redevelopment. Roof dimensions, concealed portions of the tower, secondary elevations and the later gallery roofs are estimates.
The temporary exhibition banner and street furnishings are outside this architectural scope.
The original elevation field is preserved. Local floor and threshold levels are representative.
